# @helm/api-client-ts

Generated TypeScript client for Helm حلم `/v1` (used by `helm-web` and `helm-admin`).

## DO NOT EDIT

Files under `src/generated/` are **machine-generated** from `packages/openapi/openapi.yaml`.

1. Change the OpenAPI SoT.
2. Run `pnpm --filter @helm/api-client-ts codegen` (or root `pnpm codegen`).
3. Commit the regen output.

Hand edits will be overwritten and **CI fails** if regen is dirty.
